The mirror ratio is the first thing to check. The reference device M1 (W=0.6098, L=0.769) and output device M2 (W=4.092, L=0.769) give a ratio of about 6.7, while the cascode pair M3/M4 is matched at about 1.0. The spec target is ratio 1.

Output current is about 146.6 µA against a 20 µA target, a 7.3× overshoot, which matches the 633% error (the 6.7× ratio plus cascode effects). M2 is the element whose size is out of line with its partner.
